This is release 2.5.1 of the TWAIN Data Source Manager.  There haven't been any
code changes since 2.5.0.  None of the binaries were recompiled since 2.5.0.

The Windows binaries had their file and product version bumped to 2.5.1 and the
copyright updated.  They've also been resigned with a certificate that's SHA-512
and RSA-4096.  

The Linux binaries are completely unchanged, and remain at version 2.5.0.

Releases accompany updates to the TWAIN Specification, even when there are no
actual code changes in the DSM.  We do this to reduce confusion even though all
DSMs must interoperate with any application or data source, regardless of their
supported TWAIN Protocol.

Release Notes:

- Resigned with a new certificate (windows only)
